responsibility: Implements GCC’s lightweight DOM-style JSON value hierarchy and text serialization. It provides the concrete behavior for ordered JSON objects, arrays, integer and floating-point numbers, strings with escaping, and literals, including ownership/destruction rules and pretty_printer-based output, so compiler subsystems such as optimization-record emission can build structured JSON trees deterministically and dump them as textual JSON.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the json group: it defines object/array/value behavior, ownership, escaping, and pretty-printer serialization. Unlike json.h, which declares the JSON class hierarchy and kind enum, this file supplies the concrete DOM operations and text output.
